definitions.explanation: A person who learns from a master, especially in traditional arts, martial arts, crafts, or religious contexts. Implies a close mentorship relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弟子|でし}だ。
examples.english: He is a disciple of a famous painter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{弟子|でし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The relationship between master and disciple is special.

examples.japanese: {弟子|でし}⟦{入|い}り→弟子入り：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{志願|しがん}した→志願：12669_shigan⟧。
examples.english: I applied to become an apprentice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弟子|でし}{入|い}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}した→修行：05522_shugyou⟧。
examples.english: I became an apprentice when I was young and trained for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弟子|でし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{弟子|でし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: That master has many disciples, but the top disciple is said to be especially skilled.

notes:
USAGE: More formal than ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧ (student) and implies a traditional master-apprentice relationship.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {弟子|でし}{入|い}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become an apprentice)
- ⟦{内|うち}{弟子|でし}→内弟子：noentry⟧ (live-in apprentice)
- ⟦{高|たか}{弟|でい}→高弟：noentry⟧ (top disciple, senior student)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧ (master) - the teacher in this relationship
- ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧ - student (more general, school context)
- ⟦{門下生|もんかせい}→門下生：17733_monkasei⟧ - student of a school/tradition
